b3cc228fa997d48d.description: Job description Job Title: Chief Specialist – Acceleration Asset Ramp-up Reporting To: Director, Technology Development Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Technology Enablement Grade: M13 Why This Role Matters The Chief Specialist – Acceleration Asset Ramp-up exists to help Ma’aden bring mining and processing assets to stable, productive operation faster. The role connects technology, operational expertise, data and analytics to address the constraints that slow commissioning, stabilization and early operational performance. The role creates value by identifying the highest-impact opportunities across throughput, recovery, uptime, cost and production readiness, then translating them into practical interventions that accelerate performance improvement. It provides an enterprise perspective across assets, enabling successful approaches to be reused rather than solved independently at each operation. Working across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI and project stakeholders, the role strengthens the transition from commissioning to reliable operations and embeds repeatable approaches that improve the performance of future asset ramp-ups. What You Will Deliver Asset Ramp-up & Performance Shape and embed an enterprise approach to asset ramp-up that shortens the path from commissioning to stable operations across mining and processing assets. Identify and activate the critical throughput, recovery, uptime, cost and readiness levers that accelerate early-stage asset performance. Diagnose systemic ramp-up constraints and enable focused interventions that address root causes and protect production value. Value Realization Translate ramp-up opportunities into measurable value hypotheses, performance targets and interventions with clear ownership and benefit tracking. Drive sustained improvements in ramp-up speed, asset utilization and operational readiness through fact-based performance management. Provide actionable insights that enable leadership to prioritize interventions and investments against the areas of greatest operational value. Digital & Analytics Enablement Accelerate the application of advanced analytics, digital twins and predictive capabilities where they improve commissioning, stabilization and ramp-up decisions. Embed relevant digital capabilities into operational workflows to strengthen real-time visibility, decision quality and performance management. Enable repeatable ramp-up use cases to scale across assets in partnership with technology, data and solution teams. Enterprise Execution & Governance Orchestrate alignment across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI, projects and commissioning stakeholders to resolve cross-functional dependencies and barriers. Establish consistent governance, performance measures and executive-level visibility across priority ramp-up initiatives. Strengthen the transition between project, commissioning and operational teams through clear performance expectations and integrated execution. Standards & Organizational Capability Develop and embed scalable ramp-up playbooks, tools and practices appropriate to different asset classes and operating environments. Convert lessons from asset ramp-ups into reusable organizational knowledge that improves subsequent commissioning and stabilization. Build organizational capability through technical coaching, knowledge transfer and adoption of proven ramp-up practices. What Success Looks Like Reduced time from commissioning to stable and targeted operating performance. Improved throughput, recovery, uptime and asset utilization during ramp-up. Measurable value realized from prioritized digital, analytics and operational interventions. Reduced recurrence of ramp-up constraints through effective root-cause resolution and reuse of lessons learned. Increased adoption of standardized ramp-up methods, playbooks and proven use cases across applicable assets. Stronger visibility of ramp-up performance, risks and value realization to enable faster management decisions. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mining, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is advantageous. Experience 12–15+ years of relevant experience in mining, mineral processing or comparable heavy industry environments. Significant exposure to asset commissioning, operational ramp-up, stabilization and performance improvement. Experience delivering operational value through digital, analytics or technology-enabled improvement initiatives. Experience working across multidisciplinary operational, technical, project and technology stakeholders. Skills That Matter Asset ramp-up and commissioning optimization Mining and processing operational excellence Production performance and bottleneck analysis Advanced analytics and digital enablement Value realization and benefits management Performance management and KPI design Strategic problem-solving Cross-functional execution Senior stakeholder influencing Change and capability building Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

b34e46e642f3eb8c.description: About the Role Pareto People is seeking a Child Development Consultant to support a high-profile family enterprise in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah. This part-time role focuses on the holistic, non-academic development of children aged 3–10, with an emphasis on soft skills, character building, and emotional intelligence. The consultant will design and implement tailored developmental programs and collaborate with parents and caregivers. Role Context and Objectives This position is distinct from traditional educational or tutoring roles. The primary objective is to nurture future leaders within a large, multigenerational family enterprise by focusing on personal growth, leadership foundations, social competence, and problem-solving skills. The consultant will ensure consistency in approach and reinforcement of learning in daily life through collaborative efforts with the family. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement individualized, developmentally appropriate programs focused on soft skills and personal growth. Create engaging, play-based learning experiences that promote emotional intelligence, leadership potential, communication, confidence, empathy, problem-solving, teamwork, and collaboration. Regularly assess each child’s progress and adapt strategies accordingly. Utilize creative, interactive, and experiential learning methods, incorporating cultural sensitivity and family values. Work closely with parents to align developmental goals with family expectations and long-term objectives. Engage nannies and caregivers through guidance, coaching, and structured involvement. Maintain detailed records of developmental milestones, strengths, and areas for improvement. Prepare periodic progress reports and provide professional recommendations for ongoing developmental support. Maintain the highest level of discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism, respecting family privacy and cultural norms. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Child Development, Developmental Psychology, Early Childhood Studies, or a related field. Minimum of 5-10 years of experience working with children aged 3–10 in a developmental, mentoring, or coaching capacity. Demonstrated experience in non-academic child development, outside formal schooling or classroom teaching. Strong background in play-based learning, emotional intelligence, and behavioral development. Experience working with high-profile or private families is preferred. Work Environment This is a part-time position based in the Makkah region, serving families in Jeddah and Makkah. The role requires close collaboration with family members and caregivers within a private family enterprise setting. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

b397753fae9d0ae1.job_title: Manager Operational Technology Infra Structure Hosting & Connectivity
b397753fae9d0ae1.description: About the Role Ma'aden is seeking a Manager, Operational Technology Infra-Structure, Hosting & Connectivity to lead the operational technology (OT) infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity environments. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performance industrial technology services across various sites. The manager will oversee the operation and lifecycle of OT compute, storage, virtualization, edge platforms, hosted OT systems, and industrial network connectivity, supporting safe operations, digital initiatives, data platforms, and enterprise integration. Key Responsibilities Operate and maintain OT servers, storage, virtualization, hosting platforms, and edge compute environments across industrial sites. Ensure the availability, performance, capacity, and reliability of hosted OT systems, including MES, LIMS, historians, and edge nodes. Execute routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, backups, lifecycle management, and infrastructure health monitoring activities. Operate and maintain OT network infrastructure across plant, site, and industrial control environments. Ensure stable, resilient, and secure connectivity between OT systems, plant networks, data platforms, and upstream enterprise systems. Implement OT infrastructure, hosting, connectivity, and edge platform standards across sites and operational environments. Support the modernization of legacy hardware, operating systems, virtualized environments, industrial networks, and hosted OT platforms. Implement redundancy, backup, recovery, monitoring, incident response, and operational resilience practices for OT infrastructure and hosted systems. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring OT infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity issues. Lead the OT infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity team in delivering reliable operational support and improvement initiatives. Manage vendor support, service delivery, technical escalations, maintenance windows, and infrastructure delivery commitments. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required. Demonstrated ability to manage OT infrastructure and hosting operations. Experience overseeing OT networks and connectivity. Proven track record in driving standardization and modernization initiatives. Capability to ensure reliability and operational resilience in critical environments. Experience in leading teams, managing vendors, and executing cross-functional projects. Desired Outcomes Success in this role will be demonstrated by OT infrastructure, hosting platforms, and connectivity services operating reliably with strong availability, performance, and capacity control. Hosted OT systems, including MES, LIMS, historians, and edge platforms, will be effectively maintained, patched, upgraded, and monitored. Industrial network connectivity will be stable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise OT standards. The individual will ensure that legacy infrastructure modernization and lifecycle activities are executed with minimal disruption to operations, and incidents are resolved quickly with recurring issues addressed through root-cause actions, leading to improved operational resilience over time.

b3dd06d227a2cea2.job_title: Principal Specialist Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
b3dd06d227a2cea2.description: About Ma'aden Ma'aden, established in 1997, is a global mining company and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is focused on developing the mining industry to become a key economic pillar in Saudi Arabia by building an integrated mining value chain. This full-time role is based in Riyadh. Role Overview The Principal Specialist, Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, will lead advanced data science and analytics initiatives within the Agentic AI department. This role involves translating business problems into scalable analytical solutions, AI-enabled insights, predictive models, and decision intelligence products. The specialist will contribute to building enterprise capabilities that leverage trusted data, machine learning, automation, and agentic AI concepts to enhance productivity, operational performance, and business decision-making. Key Responsibilities Translate business priorities, operational challenges, and use cases into clear data science problem statements, analytical approaches, and measurable outcomes. Design and deliver predictive, prescriptive, diagnostic, and exploratory analytics solutions that support decision-making across business and operational domains. Develop machine learning models, statistical analyses, simulations, optimization approaches, and advanced analytics products using enterprise data assets. Support the development of agentic AI use cases by defining data, model, workflow, evaluation, and decision-support requirements. Collaborate with AI engineers, platform teams, data engineers, and business stakeholders to embed analytics and machine learning into autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. Create reusable analytical assets, data science patterns, feature logic, model components, and decision intelligence products that can scale across business domains. Apply appropriate data science governance practices for model validation, performance monitoring, bias checks, versioning, deployment readiness, and lifecycle management. Provide expert guidance to analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business teams on analytical methods, model design, evaluation, and adoption. Advise stakeholders on what analytics or AI can realistically solve, required data readiness, implementation complexity, and expected value. Communicate insights, risks, limitations, and recommended actions clearly to technical, operational, and executive stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in data science and artificial intelligence. Demonstrated ability to ensure analytical outputs are interpretable, actionable, repeatable, and aligned with business value, adoption needs, and governance requirements. Experience in defining evaluation approaches for AI-enabled insights, model performance, business impact, human oversight, and continuous improvement. Proficiency in integrating analytics into dashboards, workflows, applications, copilots, and AI agents for improved decision support. Ability to maintain clear documentation covering assumptions, data sources, model logic, limitations, controls, and expected business usage. Experience in monitoring solution performance after deployment and recommending improvements based on usage, feedback, model drift, data quality, and business impact. Success Factors Successful candidates will effectively translate business problems into clear data science use cases and analytical approaches with measurable value outcomes. Success is also measured by the delivery of predictive, prescriptive, and decision intelligence solutions that demonstrate strong technical quality and practical business relevance. This includes supporting Agentic AI use cases with trusted data, robust models, evaluation methods, controls, and human oversight, ensuring analytics and AI products are reusable, documented, governed, monitored, and aligned with responsible AI expectations. Ultimately, success involves providing stakeholders with clear insights, recommendations, and decision support that improve productivity, performance, and adoption.

b309f2cd7e726953.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اليسن فالي عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير التنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات السوق للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها النهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة ووفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير الاستراتيجيات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات وتحليل السوق. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة اليسن فالي. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة اليسن فالي.

b3151b8e9b3ab950.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التحسين العالمية عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، والإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0-1 سنة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج وتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير التنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع برنامج زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير الاستراتيجيات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات وتحليل الأسعار. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم الأهداف التسويقية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة التحسين العالمية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

b3292a689f11f7d8.description: About BAN Tourism BAN Tourism is a Saudi destination management company (DMC) that specializes in designing and operating tourism programs across the Kingdom. The company serves a diverse clientele, including corporates, government entities, delegations, VIPs, and individual travelers. The Role of Sales & Reservations Executive BAN Tourism is seeking a Sales & Reservations Executive to manage customer inquiries, convert them into confirmed bookings, and coordinate reservations with suppliers. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and serves as the initial point of contact for guests and a link between sales and operations teams. Key Responsibilities Respond to customer inquiries via WhatsApp, email, and phone in a timely and professional manner. Prepare quotations and follow up with customers until booking confirmation. Promote and sell BAN’s ready-made products and tailor-made programs. Book hotels, transportation, activities, and other services with suppliers. Send booking confirmations and prepare trip files for the operations team. Maintain accurate customer and booking records in the CRM system. Track sales performance and report on inquiries, conversions, and revenue. Required Qualifications Saudi national. Bachelor’s degree in Tourism, Hospitality, Business, or a related field. Strong communication skills in both Arabic and English, written and spoken. Customer-focused with a strong sales and follow-up mindset. Organized and detail-oriented, capable of handling multiple requests simultaneously. Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with a CRM or booking system is an advantage. Experience in sales, reservations, or customer service within the tourism or hospitality sector is an advantage. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

b3301f043f30e53c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض أو الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتقديم الدعم الفني لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية والمعدات، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات، ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين المشاركين في تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ عمل الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومكوناتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعاون مع المهندسين والعمال الآخرين. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة. ستكون مواقع العمل في الرياض أو الخرج. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

b382c44f17d93cd6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الظهران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والأنظمة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل التشغيلية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الهندسية، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية بدقة. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بمتابعة المشاريع والأعمال الهندسية الكهربائية. ملخص الوظيفة المسمى الوظيفي: مهندس كهربائي الشركة: مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات الموقع: الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل سنوات الخبرة: 2-5 سنوات الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات.

b38ae1557ad03bf8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لاند مارك العربية عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات واستخداماتها وأسعارها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة تتعلق بالمنتجات، بما في ذلك الاستخدامات والأسعار. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر لضمان بيئة تسوق منظمة. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة بكفاءة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة المهام اليومية المتعلقة بالمبيعات والمخزون في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

b399868ec25d8703.description: About Ma'aden Ma'aden, established in 1997, is one of the fastest-growing mining companies globally and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is focused on developing the mining industry to become a key pillar of Saudi Arabia’s economy by building a world-class, integrated mining value chain. Role Overview Ma'aden is seeking a Lead Specialist, Category (Facility Management) to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing and executing category strategies to ensure safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective facility services across Ma'aden's operations. The specialist will translate business requirements into suitable sourcing and contracting solutions, enhance supplier performance, support local content and sustainability objectives, and safeguard service continuity for critical workplaces and operating sites. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Facility Management category strategies aligned with business requirements, demand plans, and corporate procurement objectives. Lead end-to-end sourcing for integrated and specialized facility services, including hard services, soft services, maintenance, cleaning, catering, landscaping, pest control, waste management, and related workplace services. Conduct market analysis, supplier benchmarking, demand analysis, and cost modeling to identify opportunities for cost optimization, service improvement, consolidation, and innovation. Define sourcing plans, statements of work, service specifications, commercial evaluation models, negotiation strategies, award recommendations, and contract documentation in line with procurement governance. Negotiate pricing, service levels, performance mechanisms, contract terms, amendments, and change orders to optimize total cost and mitigate commercial, operational, compliance, and continuity risks. Partner with business units, site services, HSE, finance, legal, local content, and other stakeholders to validate requirements and implement sourcing decisions. Monitor supplier and contract performance against KPIs, SLAs, statutory requirements, HSE standards, and corrective-action plans. Embed local content, sustainability, energy efficiency, digitalization, and continuous-improvement criteria into tenders and supplier performance reviews. Maintain accurate sourcing records, savings tracking, risk registers, supplier performance data, and audit-ready documentation. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in category management, particularly within facility management. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute comprehensive category strategies. Experience in leading end-to-end sourcing processes for diverse facility services. Proficiency in market analysis, supplier benchmarking, and cost modeling. Strong negotiation skills for pricing, service levels, and contract terms. Success Factors Timely implementation of Facility Management contracts, delivering measurable cost optimization, value, and service reliability. Maintenance of safe, compliant, operational, and fit-for-purpose facilities through defined scopes, performance standards, and supplier accountability. Early identification and mitigation of service continuity and supplier risks through effective contracting, contingency planning, and performance management. Clear stakeholder alignment throughout sourcing, mobilization, transition, and contract-management activities. Reliable governance for tracking and reporting supplier performance, local content contribution, sustainability outcomes, and improvement actions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to the strategic growth of Ma'aden and the mining industry in Saudi Arabia.

b39a48c44febbdce.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Senior Accountant Accounts Receivable to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting invoicing, payment processing, and account reconciliation to ensure timely collection of outstanding payments. The position is critical for maintaining accurate financial records, resolving billing issues, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure smooth operations and cash flow. Key Responsibilities Assist in preparing and issuing customer invoices accurately and on time. Apply incoming payments to customer accounts and ensure all transactions are properly documented. Monitor customer accounts for non-payment, delayed payment, and irregularities. Perform collection activities, including contacting customers via phone or email. Reconcile the accounts receivable ledger to ensure all payments are accurately recorded and posted. Support the month-end closing process by preparing AR reports and summaries. Assist in resolving billing discrepancies and respond promptly to customer inquiries. Maintain organized, up-to-date financial records and documentation. Collaborate with sales and customer service teams to resolve client account issues. Role Accountabilities Continuously obtain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve any related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in accounts receivable or a similar financial role.

b39e50c9ef02dbab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة الوطنية للصناعات الميكانيكية عن فني صيانة آلات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة المخططات المتعلقة بتركيب وصيانة الآلات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات التشغيل، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الفنية المتعلقة بتنفيذ أعمال التركيب والصيانة للآلات الكهربائية ذات التيار المتناوب والمستمر. متابعة عمليات تركيب الآلات الكهربائية والإشراف على إجراءات التشغيل الخاصة بها. إجراء الفحوص النهائية قبل التشغيل للآلات الكهربائية، وتنفيذ الفحوص الدورية للتأكد من صلاحيتها، مثل فحوص العازلية والتأريض والدوران وارتفاع درجة الحرارة وتيار بدء الحركة. تشخيص الأعطال في الآلات الكهربائية وأنظمة تشغيلها، ومتابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لهذه الآلات وأنظمتها. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال صيانة الآلات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية والفنية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة الآلات الكهربائية بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على الحفاظ على كفاءة وسلامة الآلات الكهربائية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق الشركة الوطنية للصناعات الميكانيكية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.

b3c924158c4afea6.description: About the Role MAFAS-Mahmal Facilities Services is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join their team in Makkah, with work also extending to Jeddah. This full-time role involves overseeing and coordinating electrical maintenance activities within a facility management context, ensuring the efficient and safe operation of electrical systems. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate electrical maintenance activities, including both preventive and corrective maintenance. Ensure the proper operation and maintenance of electrical systems, equipment, panels, generators, UPS systems, and lighting. Monitor maintenance activities to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and within required timeframes. Review electrical issues, identify root causes, and implement appropriate corrective actions. Prepare and review maintenance reports, inspection records, and technical documentation. Coordinate with technicians, subcontractors, suppliers, and client representatives for smooth execution of maintenance. Monitor the condition and performance of electrical equipment and recommend necessary repairs or replacements. Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, applicable codes, standards, and HSE requirements. Support the planning and implementation of preventive maintenance programs. Follow up on work orders, breakdowns, and maintenance requests, ensuring timely closure. Assist in managing spare parts, materials, and tools required for electrical maintenance. Participate in inspections, testing, commissioning, and technical assessments as required. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum of 10 years of experience in the field. Previous experience in Facility Management is mandatory, with at least 5 years in a similar role. Strong knowledge of electrical systems, maintenance practices, and troubleshooting techniques. Experience in both preventive and corrective maintenance. Good knowledge of HSE requirements and electrical safety standards. Required Skills Strong communication and coordination skills. Proven problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple maintenance activities effectively. Capacity to work efficiently under pressure. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic facility management environment, coordinating with various stakeholders to ensure operational excellence. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b3f0de325d13774d.description: About Hikma Pharmaceuticals Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC is a global pharmaceutical company with over 45 years of experience in providing high-quality medicines. With a team of over 9,500 employees, 29 manufacturing plants, and 9 R&D centers across MENA, North America, and Europe, Hikma focuses on improving access to medicine through its portfolio of over 800 generic, specialty, and branded pharmaceutical products. The Role of Shipping Officer (Tamheer Program) Hikma Pharmaceuticals is seeking a Shipping Officer to join its team in Riyadh as part of the Tamheer Program. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are looking to develop their skills in logistics and supply chain operations within the pharmaceutical industry. The role involves coordinating shipping activities and ensuring efficient documentation and communication. Key Responsibilities Demonstrating organizational ethics and values, aligning behavior and actions accordingly. Collecting pertinent information required for establishing shipping plans. Identifying local shipments to complete necessary preparations for the shipping process. Communicating with the warehouse function to inform them of daily required shipments and facilitate necessary actions. Completing all paperwork and issuing invoices in a timely manner to facilitate the shipping process. Updating the SAP System with related shipping function transactions daily to ensure alignment with all concerned functions. Documenting, filing, and maintaining all shipping function papers and documents, including shipping companies’ schedules, invoices, Air Way Bills (AWB’s), and shipping orders. Following up with shipping companies on shipping schedules and status. Performing other job-related duties as assigned by the direct supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to adhere to ethical standards and company values. Proficiency in managing documentation and administrative tasks. Experience with SAP System transactions is preferred. Candidate Profile Hikma seeks candidates who are innovative, driven to learn, caring, and collaborative. The ideal candidate will be genuinely compassionate in their work and eager to solve problems as part of a team that values impact and progress. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and operates within a culture that prioritizes employee wellbeing and encourages professional development. Hikma fosters an inclusive environment where contributions from all team members are valued.

b37d190d63adcd64.description: Job description Company: Abdul Latif Jameel Logistics ALJ Logistics operates within Abdul Latif Jameel's transportation business, focusing on logistics operations and commercial services. Its activities include freight forwarding, transportation, warehousing, customs coordination, and cross-border logistics. Role Purpose: Develop and manage strategic partnerships with government entities and public-sector stakeholders to position the company for national logistics initiatives, public-sector opportunities, regulatory collaboration, and long-term growth aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. Key Activities: Define and execute the government partnership strategy and stakeholder engagement plan for the logistics business. Identify public-sector opportunities, programs, tenders, concessions, and partnership models aligned with company capabilities. Provide leadership with structured updates on stakeholder priorities, opportunity pipelines, risks, and required decisions. Lead relationship management with ministries, authorities, regulators, and government-owned organizations. Align Legal, Finance, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate Affairs on partnership requirements and commitments. Coordinate internal teams to develop compliant proposals, business cases, memoranda of understanding, and partnership agreements. Monitor relevant regulations, national programs, and sector developments; translate them into business implications and actions. Maintain governance, transparency, and proper documentation for all government engagements and commitments. Develop innovative public-private partnership concepts and national logistics solutions that create measurable economic and service value. Skills Job Related Skills: Strategic Thinking Stakeholder Management Influencing Executive Stakeholder Management Negotiation and Influencing Strategic Partnership Development Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Logistics, Economics, or a related field. Postgraduate qualification is preferred. Minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
